title: Rust Clean Refactor Wave 12 — Energy Engine, Architect Program, Architect Plugin
description: Wave 12 of repo-wide Rust cleanup campaign (zero rustc/clippy warnings, Result<_,String> migrated to thiserror, non-test panics reduced, cargo fmt) for three large newcomer crates that are permanent workspace members with active owning tickets: energy/engine/rs (energy_engine, ~13.5k lines, 13 unwraps, audit for missed Result<String>), architect/program/rs (architect_program, ~12.6k lines), architect/plugin/rs (architect_plugin). These crates belong to other in-flight tickets (energy BEM modeling, architect completeness) — read the current git diff for each before editing, keep changes additive/minimal (fix only compiler/clippy-flagged issues plus Result<String>->thiserror migration for genuinely fallible functions), do not restructure/redesign domain logic, and never delete in-progress wiring (use #[allow(dead_code, reason=\"...\")] + BLOCKERS.md note instead). Follow framework/core thiserror template (region //#region ⚠️ Errors, enum name <CrateNoun>Error). Coordinate via campaign folder LOCKS/API-CHANGELOG/CONFLICTS/BLOCKERS files at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ueli-Documents-semio/ed30c89d-3941-44d3-ae21-abf565db2f2f/scratchpad/rust-clean-refactor-campaign, verify both native and wasm32-unknown-unknown targets where relevant with isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR, and produce per-crate reports before closing.
